name: ESP OpenOCD
description: OpenOCD for ESP32 selected by pinned ESP-IDF ddb3852ab5c7f9e6dbc268203ef9d612de391bf8.
notes: Original archive selected by ESP-IDF ddb3852ab5c7f9e6dbc268203ef9d612de391bf8 tools/tools.json (v0.12.0-esp32-20260831); SHA-256, size, root layout and ELF dependencies verified without executing the payload. Extract the single upstream root into toolchain; the SDK links it back under the exact upstream tools/<name>/<version>/<root> layout. Native libusb-1.0 and its libudev dependency are required even for --version; zlib is supplied by linux-network-libs. Version qualification does not prove USB device forwarding or hardware debugging.
